name: Banana Xanthomonas Wilt
description: A highly destructive bacterial disease causing rapid wilting, fruit rot, and plant death. It is spread by insects, tools, and infected planting material. BXW is a major threat to plantain and banana production in Africa.
symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of leaves progressing from older to younger
Premature fruit ripening with yellow, rotten pulp
Yellow ooze or bacterial exudate from cut surfaces
causes: Transmission by insects visiting male flowers
Rain splash spreading bacteria between plants
treatments: Remove and bury infected plants deeply
Disinfect tools with bleach or alcohol between plants
Apply copper-based bactericides as preventive spray
prevention: Sterilize tools with bleach or alcohol after each plant
Remove male buds (de-budding) to reduce insect transmission
Report suspected cases to agricultural extension services
Practice field sanitation and restrict field access
